content.short: Openmesh Network builds a decentralized cloud, data, and oracle network without a middleman.
content.description: Openmesh Network is an immutable, decentralized cloud and oracle network developed over the past four years. It brings together the security of Ethereum, the scalability of robust cloud infrastructure, and the reliability of Chainlink's decentralized oracles in one integrated solution. The team draws on experience from projects such as Fantom, Ripple, and Cosmos. Openmesh envisions a world where trust is embedded in design itself, rather than in brands or the people operating it.
